title: Content Studio workflow
purpose: Translate the research into a user-facing workflow.
takeaway: Review a page, score several target queries, and inspect attributed draft changes in one workflow.

bullets: Load a saved example or paste HTML, Markdown, or text.
Inspect retained blocks, review flags, and per-query scores.
Generate attributed edits and compare scores before export.

speaker_notes: The app processes submitted content in memory and never fetches or executes it.
open_questions: Capture a current screenshot after the demo flow is frozen.
